headline: Calibrated replay fails research rule 21 (69% of live trades matched within 5 minutes) - it prices trades right but picks a different set; owner gets a decision on matching by decision bar (PR #187).
bullets: FWDCAL: matched trades are within +0.006R of live; misses come from missing signals (35%), the caps cascade (34%) and the spread-quote filter (32%). No replay result is used.

Fill latency: live entry times are broker fill times, 0.5-1.2 min after the decision bar, so exact-minute matching can never reach 95%; DECISION RULE21-DB proposes decision-bar matching with R-gap guards.
Reps: rating the 39 unrated setups adds ~+47 setup-days/week (~+10%), mostly 22 Generator setups.
The Generator account fills about twice as slowly as the others; its R cost isn't measured yet.
Next: replay the logged live spread quotes, then a fresh rule-21 audit on 11-12..11-13.
